routines.semantics: Load a CK into the process/module CK search list and return the actual CSPICE numeric handle. Most recently loaded file is searched first; reloading an already loaded file moves it to highest priority and returns the same physical handle. CKLPF does not register the kernel in the FURNSH table. Handles share native CSPICE state; they are not portable to an isolated worker/WASM module.

scenarios.observes: cklpf opens CK for subsequent query and closes via ckupf Baseline object inspection alone does not establish CKLPF search-list effects; authored priority and KTOTal cases provide that evidence.

Missing file must reach the actual raw/CSPICE operation and return FILENOTFOUND; host fixture read errors cannot satisfy it. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Actual A/B/reloaded-A file search order changes the full pointing/AV result; duplicate loads share a native handle and one unload removes that file while B remains searchable. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Manual CK loading makes actual pointing available but does not create a FURNSH table entry; ktotal(CK)=0 and full pointing are both observed. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

routines.edgeAssessment: A/B/reloaded-A search priority is observed through actual complete CKGPAV results. Literal AV sequences distinguish A,B,A,B,B; KTOTal CK stays zero for manual loads.
routines.errorAssessment: Missing file is actual FILENOTFOUND, not an fs.readFileSync error. Duplicate workflow labels fail before acquiring an untracked raw load. Actual CSPICE duplicate-file aliases are permitted.

routines.cleanup: Per-case kclear/reset and backend dispose run in finally. Pending CK handles close explicitly before Scratch deletion; an initial failed close retains the claim for retry before file deletion. Actual Python pending error is cleared before close. Cells/windows are registered once and freed after use; duplicate physical CK handles retain CSPICE global-state alias semantics. WASM allocation fault injection covers21positions with zero net leaks and subsequent actual lookup. Scoped Python found-check setting restores on all paths.
routines.tolerance: Unchanged live1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparator applies to all9matrix/3AV/clock/coverage outputs; IDs, found flags and states exact. Authored rotation angles and AV rates give nonzero components above tolerance. Independent Rodrigues uses1e-12; generator derivative h=.001uses separate1e-10 bound for central-difference roundoff, not relaxed live comparison.

findings.summary: Previous open/query/close or void/error smoke cases did not establish CK search-list effects, positive all-component pointing, accumulation and actual scientific boundaries.
findings.repair: A/B/reloaded-A search priority is observed through actual complete CKGPAV results. Literal AV sequences distinguish A,B,A,B,B; KTOTal CK stays zero for manual loads. Registered reset defaults preserve prior workflows while reset:false exercises actual caller accumulation. Meaningful live named errors and independent literal outputs distinguish matching harness mistakes.

findings.summary: Pending CK claims had no explicit close finalizer; Scratch removal preceded file cleanup, and failed closes could not be retried while their files existed.
findings.repair: Track each real load, reset captured error before explicit pending close, preserve failed claims for registered retry, append Scratch cleanup last. Actual Node/WASM and locked Python tests observe existing files for both attempts and empty claims after close; Python starts with real pending CSPICE error.

routines.semantics: Unload the CK associated with a physical CKLPF handle, removing it from search priority and closing the file. Loading the same file twice is not reference counting: either alias removes the one loaded file. An unknown actual numeric handle is a no-op; an unknown workflow label is only harness preflight. KCLEAR unloads CKs too.

scenarios.observes: ckupf unloads a CK handle previously opened by cklpf Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Representative ckupf error for unknown handle ID Harness-only unknown label preflight; does not establish a CSPICE error. Separate actual numeric unknown-handle no-op and search-effect tests provide raw evidence.

Actual unload changes which full pointing/AV solution is returned; unloading a now-unknown alias is a no-op and leaves B searchable, rather than merely matching void outputs. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Kernel clearing unloads the actual CK manager; later ckupf on that native handle is a no-op. No artificial error is required for an unloaded handle. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

After the last CK unload, actual pointing raises NOLOADEDFILES; a missing workflow label is not raw unload error evidence. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

routines.edgeAssessment: Explicit A/B/A alias unload makes B observable, repeat unknown physical unload leaves B, final close produces actual NOLOADEDFILES. KCLEAR state and pending cleanup/retry are exercised.
routines.errorAssessment: No manufactured CSPICE error for unknown valid handle. The old CKH_UNKNOWN case is explicitly a harness label error; actual unknown positive numeric handles and repeated raw unload are separately tested. Existing public nonnegative signed-int32 handle validation is preserved.

routines.semantics: Inspect a CK file by path independently of the loaded pointing search list. Append all signed instrument/object IDs into the supplied integer set, sorted and deduplicated across segments and existing content; do not silently clear caller output.

scenarios.observes: ckobj object-id query with explicit CK open/close lifecycle Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Missing file must reach the actual raw/CSPICE operation and return FILENOTFOUND; host fixture read errors cannot satisfy it. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

All signed instrument IDs from multiple segments are sorted/deduplicated; a repeated instrument appears once. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Reuse the actual named output cell across files: A contributes two instruments and B repeats one, so both IDs remain in the union. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

An actual empty CK returns an empty initialized set with zero allocated capacity. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Zero capacity is preserved rather than defaulted to32; actual populated CK must signal SETEXCESS. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

A real one-element cell cannot hold two distinct instruments; require actual SETEXCESS. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

Actual CK object inspection rejects a valid SPK DAF as INVALIDFILETYPE. Actual target raw operation reaches the recursively compared result: complete IDs/intervals/matrix/AV/clock, or named toolkit failure.

routines.edgeAssessment: Two instruments with repeated segments, existing set union across two files, duplicate append, empty CK and genuine zero capacity. Literal final sorted set [-123001,-123000] on both dispatchers proves union is not matching resets.
routines.errorAssessment: Zero populated cell and insufficient capacity require actual SETEXCESS. Wrong valid SPK DAF requires INVALIDFILETYPE and missing file FILENOTFOUND. Wrong/expired output cell and WASM module ownership have separate actual-backend guards.
